# PsyGames — cognitive brain trainers

> 61 cognitive trainers for memory, attention, logic and processing speed. The browser demo offers one short round; full training, levels and progress are available in the installed apps for macOS, Windows and Android.

## Pages
- [Home](https://psy-games.pro/)
- [Programs](https://psy-games.pro/programs/): structured cognitive-training programs
- [Trainers](https://psy-games.pro/games/): 48 trainers described page by page
- [Benefits](https://psy-games.pro/benefits/): the science behind cognitive training
- [About](https://psy-games.pro/about/)
- [Download](https://psy-games.pro/download/): macOS, Windows, Android
- [Blog](https://psy-games.pro/blog/): articles on cognition and training
- [Full text](https://psy-games.pro/llms-full.txt): every trainer, program and article in one file

## About
- 61 trainers: memory, attention, logic, speed
- Platforms: macOS, Windows, Android
- Browser demo: one short round; full training is in the installed app
- Browser demo: free; app pricing is shown on the download page or in the relevant store

## Who makes it
- Author: Denis Onosov (ODV999)
- Independent project, no ads and no account required for the browser demo
- Android build: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.psygames.app

## What makes the trainers different
- Every exercise is a validated paradigm from cognitive science, not a generic puzzle
- Each one reports a specific psychometric measure — reaction time, span, error rate, variability — instead of a single vague "brain score"
- Difficulty grows by task difficulty, not by shortening the clock
- Progress, levels and full sessions live in the installed app; the browser demo is one short round

## Programs
- Morning warm-up and an evening wind-down set, assembled from different games so the two never repeat each other
- The evening set is deliberately calm and ends with 4-7-8 breathing

## Languages
- 12: en, ru, es, pt, hi, zh, de, fr, it, ja, ko, ar. English lives at the root, the rest under /<lang>/.

## Accessibility
- Works with VoiceOver and TalkBack: controls are labelled and the game board is described in words
